slot_scores.name: purchase_beginning_of_month_timing
slot_scores.evidence_quote: When you sell in a given month, must the units sold come from the stock available at the start of that month (i.e., you cannot sell units purchased in the same month), or can you sell units purchased in the same month?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked whether units purchased in the same month can be sold, which directly resolves the timing/availability issue for purchases within a month.
